title: Eric Trump Says His Dad Is Saving God And Declares DEI Is Dead
text:
Eric Trump said in a recent interview that his father will go to heaven for everything he has done. He said this after previously former President Donald Trump told a reporter that he was not sure he was heaven-bound. Eric disagreed and said his dad has done great things that make him deserving of it.
He mentioned that his father ended Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion programs and got people to value their children again. He also claimed his dad was saving God. Eric is promoting his new book called Under Siege and has been making a number of bold statements during interviews.
Talking with Benny Johnson on the Benny Show, Eric said: “We’re saving Christianity, we’re saving God, we’re saving the family unit, we’re saving this nation.” He went on to say: “I mean, DEI is out the window, Benny. You no longer have Colin Kaepernick kneeling for the national anthem. You no longer have Budweiser going woke as hell. All of this is dead.”
He said that now people are going back to church and valuing family life again. Eric added that his father has brought peace and made people believe in the American Dream and American exceptionalism again. He called it “a beautiful time” and said this is why he believes his dad will go to heaven.

Not everyone agreed with him though. Some critics called his claim about saving God “blasphemous” and said it was mocking God. Others called it one of the strangest and most offensive things they had ever heard from the Trump family. Many questioned the idea that religion and corporate marketing should be in the same conversation.
